summary: Implemented optimizer diagnostics UI additions for optional failed case samples, failure_analysis fallback, safe metadata/raw-output handling, and optional model comparison results while preserving existing optimizer history diagnostics.
verification: Reviewer FAIL fix: nested hardware_info secret-like keys are recursively sanitized; targeted Vitest/vue-tsc/OpenSpec/diff-check reran successfully.
known_gaps: Verification ran under Node v22.19.0 while package engines request Node 20.19.x; pnpm emitted an unsupported engine warning but tests, type-check, and build completed.
Implementation assumes model comparison rows arrive on OptimizerRun.model_comparisons; the backend spec describes the display contract but does not show an exact JSON example for comparison rows.
No new endpoint was added; diagnostics are read from the existing optimizer history payload as optional fields.
